sentences.text: Guatemala -LRB- -LSB- ɡwɑːtᵻˈmɑːlə , _ ɡwæ - , _ ɡɑː - -RSB- , or ; -LSB- gwateˈmala -RSB- -RRB- , officially the Republic of Guatemala -LRB- -LSB- República de Guatemala , links = no -RSB- -RRB- , is a country in Central America bordered by Mexico to the north and west , the Pacific Ocean to the southwest , Belize to the northeast , the Caribbean to the east , Honduras to the east and El Salvador to the southeast .	Central America	Central America	Mexico	Mexico	Belize	Belize	Honduras	Honduras	El Salvador	El Salvador
With an estimated population of around 15.8 million , it is the most populated state in Central America .	Central America	Central America

Guatemala is a representative democracy ; its capital and largest city is Nueva Guatemala de la Asunción , also known as Guatemala City .	Guatemala City	Guatemala City	representative democracy	representative democracy
The territory of modern Guatemala once formed the core of the Maya civilization , which extended across Mesoamerica .	Maya	Maya peoples	Maya civilization	Maya civilization	Mesoamerica	Mesoamerica

Most of the country was conquered by the Spanish in the 16th century , becoming part of the viceroyalty of New Spain .	Spanish	Guatemalan Spanish	conquered by the Spanish	Spanish conquest of Guatemala	viceroyalty	viceroyalty	New Spain	New Spain

Guatemala attained independence in 1821 as part of the Federal Republic of Central America , which dissolved in 1841 .	Central America	Central America	Federal Republic of Central America	Federal Republic of Central America
From the mid to late 19th century , Guatemala experienced chronic instability and civil strife .
Beginning in the early 20th century , it was ruled by a series of dictators backed by the United Fruit Company and the United States government .	United Fruit Company	United Fruit Company

In 1944 , authoritarian leader Jorge Ubico was overthrown by a pro-democratic military coup , initiating a decade-long revolution that led to sweeping social and economic reforms .	Jorge Ubico	Jorge Ubico	decade-long revolution	Guatemalan Revolution
A U.S.-backed military coup in 1954 ended the revolution and installed a dictatorship .	U.S.-backed military coup	1954 Guatemalan coup d'état

From 1960 to 1996 , Guatemala endured a bloody civil war fought between the US-backed government and leftist rebels , including genocidal massacres of the Maya population perpetrated by the military .	Maya	Maya peoples	endured a bloody civil war	Guatemalan Civil War	leftist	leftist	genocidal massacres	Guatemalan genocide

Since a United Nations-negotiated peace accord , Guatemala has witnessed both economic growth and successful democratic elections , though it continues to struggle with high rates of poverty , crime , drug trade , and instability .	United Nations	United Nations
As of 2014 , Guatemala ranks 31st of 33 Latin American and Caribbean countries in terms of the Human Development Index .	Human Development Index	Human Development Index

Guatemala 's abundance of biologically significant and unique ecosystems includes a large number of endemic species and contributes to Mesoamerica 's designation as a biodiversity hotspot .	Mesoamerica	Mesoamerica	biodiversity hotspot	biodiversity hotspot
The country is also known for its rich and distinct culture , which is characterized by a fusion of Spanish and Indigenous influences .	Spanish	Guatemalan Spanish
